properties.headline: Freeze Watch issued October 16 at 8:40AM MDT until October 17 at 9:00AM MDT by NWS Pueblo CO
properties.description:
* WHAT...For the Freeze Warning, sub-freezing temperatures in the
upper 20s to lower 30s. For the Freeze Watch, sub-freezing
temperatures in the mid 20s to around 30.

* WHERE...El Paso and Kiowa counties.

* WHEN...From late tonight through Saturday morning.

* IMPACTS...Sub-freeze conditions could kill crops, other sensitive
vegetation and possibly damage unprotected outdoor plumbing.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...The coldest temperatures will occur Friday
night into Saturday morning which may bring an end to the growing
season with a prolonged period of subfreezing temperatures.
properties.areaDesc: Northern El Paso County/Monument Ridge/Rampart Range Below 7500 Ft; Colorado Springs Vicinity/Southern El Paso County/Rampart Range Below 7400 Ft; Western Kiowa County; Eastern Kiowa County

properties.headline: Freeze Watch issued October 16 at 8:40AM MDT until October 17 at 9:00AM MDT by NWS Pueblo CO
properties.description:
* WHAT...For the Frost Advisory, temperatures may briefly dip into
the lower to mid 30s resulting in frost formation or a light
freeze. For the Freeze Watch, a longer period of sub-freezing
temperatures in the mid 20s to around 30 degrees will be possible.

* WHERE...Eastern Fremont, Pueblo, Crowley, Otero, Las Animas,
Huerfano, Bent, Prowers and Baca Counties.

* WHEN...From late tonight through Saturday morning.

* IMPACTS...Frost and freeze conditions could kill crops, other
sensitive vegetation and possibly damage unprotected outdoor
plumbing.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...The coldest readings will occur Friday night
into Saturday morning with a killing freeze possible, which could
bring an end to the growing season.
